newsitem.title: ITALY: CYCLING-GOTTI HAILED ITALY'S GIRO HERO.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-GOTTI HAILED ITALY'S GIRO HERO.

text.p: Ivan Gotti ended Italy's six-year wait for a Giro d'Italia victory on Sunday.
Gotti finished the three-week race one minute 27 seconds ahead of last year's winner Pavel Tonkov of Russia.
Italian Giuseppe Guerini came third, 12:20 slower than Gotti.
Franco Chioccioli was Italy's last Giro victor in 1991.
Gotti's team mate Mario Cipollini scored his fifth stage win in the 165 km final leg from Boario Terme to Milan, outsprinting Sweden's Glenn Magnusson.
